items.text: If you have failed degree subjects or have backlogs, the sensible plan is to check your university's rules on re-attempts, make a realistic schedule to clear papers, build skills and proof in parallel and explain the gap honestly to employers.
Find out the exact rules and deadlines, clear the papers with a focused plan, and keep building one practical skill so you are not stuck if clearing takes longer.
Check official notices and talk to your department before you decide.
